About the job
At Sogeti, technology runs through our veins. It is this interest in technology that guides us daily and is reflected in our slogan "Made In Tech". Thanks to our shared passion for technology, our entrepreneurial culture, and the importance we place on continuous training, we will do everything possible to help you unlock your full potential.

Your missions

As a Data Engineer, you will have the following tasks:

Identifying data needs and business use cases (collection, transformation, exploitation of data)
Designing and implementing data architectures (data pipelines, data lake, data warehouse)
Developing, optimising and maintaining data pipelines (ETL / ELT)
Ensuring the quality, reliability and availability of data (data quality, monitoring, performance)
Automating data processing and deployments (CI/CD, industrialisation)
Collaborating with business, data and IT teams to enhance data value
Participating in acceptance phases, testing and production deployment
Presenting data solutions and results to stakeholders
Working with the stack: Python, SQL, Spark, Talend, Azure / AWS / GCP, Big Data tools
This description is not exhaustive. It may evolve depending on your experience, ongoing projects and your expectations.

Your profile

Currently studying for a Master 2 in Data Engineering
Knowledge of software development principles and best practices
Proficiency in AI
Team spirit
Autonomy and proactivity in problem-solving
Fluency in English (minimum B2 level)
Some reasons to join us

A local player: we work for leading companies and are a preferred partner for local stakeholders. By joining our agile teams, you will contribute to a unique local approach serving our clients.
100% certified: you benefit from a certification path tailored to your role and level. You are supported by experts and progress at your own pace thanks to structured self-training and a collective dynamic that accelerates your development.
Leading in emerging technologies: as the "technologist" actor of the Group, our mission is to explore and test new technologies to uncover their potential and find business uses. By joining us, you contribute to this innovation mission alongside pioneering teams such as those involved in adopting Microsoft Fabric.
Publisher partnerships to innovate together: enjoy privileged access to their roadmaps, Beta versions of their products, as well as training materials and certification vouchers
Our commitments and priorities

The Capgemini group encourages an inclusive culture within a multicultural and disability-friendly environment. By joining us, you become part of a collective that values diversity, develops the potential of its talents, engages in solidarity initiatives with its partners, and is committed to reducing its environmental impact across all its sites and with its clients.

Sogeti is part of the Capgemini group and supports organisations in implementing innovation as a local partner on a global scale. Combining agility and speed, Sogeti offers innovative solutions in testing, cloud and application development, all driven by AI, data and automation. More information at www.sogeti.com/fr
